title: Ta’lim va texnologiya mavzusi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ta’lim va texnologiya haqida boy lug‘at bilan gapirasiz, tendensiyalarni tasvirlaysiz, ishonch va shubhani bildirasiz va ikki tomonlama muvozanatli mulohaza qura olasiz.

scenes.title: Ta’lim va texnologiya
scenes.say: Hello again. Last time we studied the passive and formal style. Today we will talk about education and technology, and you will learn to discuss them clearly, carefully and with balance.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda majhul nisbat va rasmiy uslubni o‘rgandik. Bugun ta’lim va texnologiya haqida gaplashamiz. Dars oxirida siz mavzuga oid boy lug‘atni ishlatasiz, tendensiyalarni tasvirlaysiz, ishonch va shubhani bildirasiz hamda ikki tomonlama mulohazani tuzasiz. Bu IELTS speaking va writing uchun eng ko‘p uchraydigan mavzulardan biri.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Oldingi darsda majhul nisbat va rasmiy uslubni o‘rgandik. Bugun ta’lim va texnologiya haqida aniq, ehtiyotkor va muvozanatli gapirishni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Ta’lim lug‘ati

examples.t: Many students rely on a scholarship to pay their tuition fees.
examples.uz: Ko‘p talabalar o‘qish haqini to‘lash uchun stipendiyaga tayanadi.

examples.t: Plagiarism is taken very seriously at university.
examples.uz: Universitetda plagiat juda jiddiy qabul qilinadi.

scenes.say: Let us start with education vocabulary. A curriculum is the set of subjects taught. Tuition fees are the cost of teaching. Vocational training prepares you for a specific job. A dropout leaves a course early. Assessment means testing, and plagiarism means copying someone else's work.
scenes.say_native: Avval ta’lim lug‘ati. Curriculum, ya’ni o‘quv dasturi. Tuition fees, ya’ni o‘qish haqi. Scholarship, ya’ni stipendiya. Vocational training, ya’ni kasbiy ta’lim. Dropout, ya’ni o‘qishni tashlab ketgan. Assessment, ya’ni baholash. Plagiarism, ya’ni boshqaning ishini o‘zlashtirish. Bu so‘zlarni jumla ichida yodlang, alohida emas.
scenes.say_uz: Ta’lim lug‘atidan boshlaymiz. Curriculum o‘quv dasturi. Tuition fees o‘qish haqi. Vocational training kasbiy tayyorgarlik. Plagiarism boshqaning ishini nusxalash.

scenes.title: Texnologiya lug‘ati

examples.t: Digital literacy is now as important as reading and writing.
examples.uz: Raqamli savodxonlik endi o‘qish va yozish kabi muhim.

examples.t: Parents worry about screen time and data privacy.
examples.uz: Ota-onalar ekran vaqti va ma’lumotlar maxfiyligidan xavotirda.

scenes.say: Now technology. Digital literacy is the ability to use digital tools well. An e-learning platform is a website for online courses. An algorithm is a set of rules a computer follows. Screen time is the hours we spend looking at screens, and data privacy protects personal information.
scenes.say_native: Endi texnologiya. Digital literacy, ya’ni raqamli savodxonlik. E-learning platform, ya’ni onlayn o‘qitish platformasi. Algorithm, ya’ni kompyuter bajaradigan qoidalar to‘plami. Screen time, ya’ni ekran qarshisida o‘tkazilgan vaqt. Data privacy, ya’ni shaxsiy ma’lumotlar himoyasi. Cyberbullying, ya’ni internetda ta’qib qilish.
scenes.say_uz: Endi texnologiya. Raqamli savodxonlik raqamli vositalardan yaxshi foydalanish qobiliyatidir. Algoritm kompyuter bajaradigan qoidalar to‘plami. Ekran vaqti ekranga qarab o‘tkazilgan soatlar.

scenes.title: Barqaror birikmalar
board: meet a deadline, keep up with the course
bridge the gap, the digital divide

examples.t: She is pursuing a degree in computer science.
examples.uz: U kompyuter fanlari bo‘yicha daraja olish ustida o‘qiyapti.

examples.t: Cheap tablets can bridge the digital divide.
examples.uz: Arzon planshetlar raqamli tengsizlikni kamaytirishi mumkin.

scenes.say: Collocations make you sound natural. We pursue a degree, gain qualifications, meet a deadline and keep up with the course. We bridge a gap, and we talk about the digital divide between those with access to technology and those without.
scenes.say_native: B2 darajada alohida so‘zlar emas, birikmalar muhim. Pursue a degree, ya’ni daraja olish uchun o‘qish. Gain qualifications, malaka orttirish. Meet a deadline, muddatga ulgurish. Bridge the gap, tafovutni kamaytirish. The digital divide, raqamli tengsizlik. Have access to, ya’ni imkoniyatga ega bo‘lish.
scenes.say_uz: Birikmalar nutqni tabiiy qiladi: daraja olish uchun o‘qish, malaka orttirish, muddatga ulgurish, dasturdan ortda qolmaslik, tafovutni kamaytirish.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha qolipdan kelgan xatolar
board: ✗ make an exam  ✓ take / sit an exam
✗ I passed the exam, but I failed. (aralashtirish)
✗ I learn at university  ✓ I study at university
scenes.say: Do not say make an exam. Say take an exam, or in British English, sit an exam. Pass means you succeeded. And we study at university, we do not learn at university, unless we mean gaining a skill.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchi: o‘zbekcha “imtihon topshirmoq” dan “make an exam” deb tarjima qilish. To‘g‘risi: take an exam yoki inglizchada sit an exam. Ikkinchi: “pass” faqat muvaffaqiyatli topshirishni bildiradi. Natija noma’lum bo‘lsa, “take” deng. Uchinchi: universitetda o‘qishni “study” deymiz.
scenes.say_uz: Make an exam demang, take an exam yoki sit an exam deng. Pass muvaffaqiyatli topshirishni bildiradi. Universitetda study qilamiz.

scenes.title: Birikmani to‘ldiring
board: 1) She wants to ___ a degree in law.
2) I must ___ the deadline on Friday.
3) Cheap laptops help ___ the digital divide.
4) Next week I will ___ my driving test.
scenes.say: Complete the sentences. One: she wants to blank a degree in law. Two: I must blank the deadline on Friday. Three: cheap laptops help blank the digital divide. Four: next week I will blank my driving test.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchi gapda daraja uchun o‘qish, ikkinchisida muddatga ulgurish, uchinchisida tafovutni kamaytirish, to‘rtinchisida imtihon topshirish kerak. Variantlar: pursue, meet, bridge, take. Har bir gapni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni to‘ldiring. U huquq bo‘yicha daraja olishni xohlaydi. Men juma kuni muddatga ulgurishim kerak. Arzon noutbuklar raqamli tengsizlikni kamaytirishga yordam beradi. Kelasi hafta men haydash imtihonini topshiraman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: pursue. Two: meet. Three: bridge. Four: take, or sit in British English.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: pursue a degree. Ikki: meet a deadline, “meet” bu yerda “yetib kelmoq, bajarmoq” ma’nosida. Uch: bridge the digital divide, ya’ni ikki tomon orasidagi tafovutni yo‘qotish. To‘rt: take a test yoki sit a test. Agar “do a test” yoki “make a test” degan bo‘lsangiz, yuqoridagi xatoni eslang. Bu birikmalar IELTS’da juda foydali.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: pursue. Ikki: meet. Uch: bridge. To‘rt: take, yoki britaniya inglizchasida sit.

scenes.title: Tendensiyalarni tasvirlash: fe’llar

examples.t: The number of online students has grown rapidly.
examples.uz: Onlayn talabalar soni tez o‘sdi.

examples.t: Enrolment declined in 2020.
examples.uz: Qabul 2020 yilda kamaydi.

scenes.say: To describe a trend, use verbs of movement. Up: rise, increase, grow, climb. Down: fall, decline, drop, decrease. No change: remain stable or level off. Up and down: fluctuate. Peak means reaching the highest point.
scenes.say_native: Tendensiyani tasvirlash uchun harakat fe’llari kerak. Yuqoriga: rise, increase, grow, climb. Pastga: fall, decline, drop, decrease. Tebransa: fluctuate. Eng yuqori nuqtaga yetsa: peak. Eslab qoling: rise o‘timsiz, “raise” esa o‘timli: prices rise, but governments raise taxes. Bu farqni ko‘pchilik adashtiradi.
scenes.say_uz: Tendensiyalar uchun fe’llar: o‘smoq, kamaymoq, barqaror qolmoq, tebranmoq. Onlayn talabalar soni tez o‘sdi.

scenes.title: Tezlik va darajani bildirish

examples.t: There was a sharp rise in tuition fees.
examples.uz: O‘qish haqi keskin oshdi.

examples.t: Internet access has improved steadily.
examples.uz: Internetga ulanish asta-sekin yaxshilanib bordi.

scenes.say: Add adverbs to show speed. Sharply and dramatically mean very fast. Steadily and gradually mean slowly and continuously. Slightly means a small change. You can also use a noun: a sharp rise, a gradual decline, a slight fall.
scenes.say_native: Tezlik va hajmni ravishlar bilan beramiz. Sharply, dramatically, ya’ni keskin. Steadily, gradually, ya’ni muttasil, asta-sekin. Slightly, ya’ni biroz. Ikkala qolip bir xil ma’no beradi: “prices rose sharply” va “there was a sharp rise in prices”. Yozma ishda ikkala qolipni almashtirib ishlating.
scenes.say_uz: Ravishlar tezlikni ko‘rsatadi: keskin, asta-sekin, biroz. Ot bilan ham aytish mumkin: a sharp rise, a gradual decline.

scenes.title: Tendensiyada qaysi zamon?
board: Present perfect: has risen over the past decade
There has been a steady rise in ...

examples.t: The use of tablets has risen over the past decade.
examples.uz: Planshetlardan foydalanish so‘nggi o‘n yilda oshdi.

examples.t: Online learning is becoming increasingly popular.
examples.uz: Onlayn o‘qish tobora ommalashmoqda.

scenes.say: Choose the tense carefully. For a change that continues up to now, use the present perfect: has risen over the past decade. For a finished time like 2019, use the past simple. For a current change, use the present continuous with increasingly.
scenes.say_native: Zamonni to‘g‘ri tanlang. O‘tmishdan hozirgacha davom etgan o‘zgarishda present perfect: has risen over the past decade, since 2010, in recent years. Hozir kechayotgan o‘zgarishda present continuous va “increasingly”: becoming increasingly popular. Yana bir qolip: “There has been a steady rise in ...”.
scenes.say_uz: Hozirgacha davom etgan o‘zgarishda present perfect, aniq tugagan vaqtda past simple, hozirgi jarayonda present continuous ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Sabab va oqibat
board: This is due to / owing to ...
lead to, result in, contribute to
as a result of, thanks to

examples.t: Falling costs have led to wider access to technology.
examples.uz: Arzonlashish texnologiyadan kengroq foydalanishga olib keldi.

examples.t: The decline is largely due to funding cuts.
examples.uz: Pasayish asosan mablag‘ qisqarishi bilan bog‘liq.

scenes.say: To explain trends, give causes and effects. Due to and owing to introduce a cause. Lead to, result in and contribute to introduce an effect. As a result of is followed by a noun. Thanks to is used for positive causes.
scenes.say_native: Tendensiyani sababi bilan birga aytsangiz, javob chuqurroq eshitiladi. Sabab: due to, owing to, as a result of, ularning ortidan ot yoki ot birikmasi keladi. Oqibat: lead to, result in, contribute to, ham ot bilan. Thanks to faqat yaxshi sabab uchun. Oldingi darsdagi majhul nisbatni shu yerda qo‘llang.
scenes.say_uz: Sabab: due to, owing to, as a result of. Oqibat: lead to, result in, contribute to. Thanks to yaxshi sabab uchun ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Raqamlarni tasvirlashdagi xatolar
board: ✗ an increase by 10%  ✓ an increase of 10%
✗ rose to 5 from 3  ✓ rose from 3 to 5
✗ The number of students are ...  ✓ is ...
scenes.say: Prepositions matter. We say increased by ten percent for the amount of change, and rose from three to five. But we say an increase of ten percent. And the number of students is, singular. A number of students are, plural.
scenes.say_native: Predloglarda xato eng ko‘p. Fe’l bilan: increased BY 10 percent, rose FROM 3 TO 5. Ot bilan: an increase OF 10 percent. Ikkinchi nozik nuqta: “the number of students” bilan fe’l birlikda: the number of students is growing. “A number of students” esa “bir qancha talaba” degani va ko‘plik: a number of students are online.
scenes.say_uz: Increased by 10 percent, an increase of 10 percent, rose from 3 to 5. The number of students is, a number of students are.

scenes.title: Grafikni so‘zlarda tasvirlang
scenes.say: Describe three trends. One: online students rose from two million in two thousand fifteen to six million in two thousand twenty. Two: university fees went from three thousand to nine thousand pounds. Three: the dropout rate stayed at eight percent.
scenes.say_native: Uchta ma’lumotni so‘z bilan tasvirlang. Birinchisi: onlayn talabalar 2015 dan 2020 gacha 2 milliondan 6 milliongacha. Ikkinchisi: o‘qish haqi 3 000 funtdan 9 000 funtgacha. Uchinchisi: o‘qishni tashlab ketish 8 foizda qoldi. Present perfect yoki past simple, sharply va steadily kabi ravishlar va to‘g‘ri predloglardan foydalaning.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta tendensiyani tasvirlang. Onlayn talabalar ikki milliondan olti milliongacha o‘sdi. O‘qish haqi uch mingdan to‘qqiz ming funtgacha oshdi. Tashlab ketish darajasi sakkiz foizda qoldi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) rose sharply from 2 million to 6 million
scenes.say: Model answers. One: online student numbers rose sharply from two million to six million. Two: fees tripled from three thousand to nine thousand pounds. Three: the dropout rate remained stable at eight percent.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Bir: The number of online students rose sharply from 2 million to 6 million. Ikki: University fees tripled, ya’ni uch baravar oshdi, 3 000 dan 9 000 funtgacha. Uch: The dropout rate remained stable at 8 percent. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lsa ham, muhimi fe’l, ravish va predlog to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi. Rasmiy matnda raqamni yozish o‘rniga tendensiyani so‘z bilan aytish ham yaxshi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: onlayn talabalar soni keskin oshdi. Ikki: o‘qish haqi uch barobar oshdi. Uch: tashlab ketish darajasi barqaror qoldi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: podkast
board: Host: Has online learning really taken off?
scenes.say: Host: Has online learning really taken off? Expert: Absolutely. Enrolment has risen steadily since twenty-fifteen, and it jumped dramatically during the pandemic. Host: Is that likely to continue? Expert: It probably will, although the figures have levelled off recently. Cost is a major factor, but opinions remain divided on quality.
scenes.say_native: Qisqa podkastni tinglang. Boshlovchi onlayn o‘qish haqiqatan ommalashdimi, deb so‘raydi. Mutaxassis tendensiyani tasvirlaydi. Eshiting: qachondan beri o‘sib bormoqda, qachon keskin sakrash bo‘lgan, hozir nima bo‘lyapti va mutaxassis qaysi masalada fikrlar bo‘lingan deydi.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchi: Onlayn o‘qish haqiqatan ommalashdimi? Mutaxassis: Albatta. Qabul 2015 yildan beri muttasil oshdi va pandemiya vaqtida keskin sakradi. Boshlovchi: Bu davom etishi mumkinmi? Mutaxassis: Ehtimol, ha, garchi so‘nggi paytda raqamlar barqarorlashgan. Xarajat muhim omil, lekin sifat bo‘yicha fikrlar bo‘lingan.

scenes.title: Podkast bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3) What has happened to the figures recently?
scenes.say: Answer. One: since when has enrolment risen? Two: when did it jump dramatically? Three: what has happened to the figures recently? Four: what are opinions divided on?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Bir: qabul qachondan beri oshmoqda? Ikki: qachon keskin sakrash bo‘ldi? Uch: so‘nggi paytda raqamlarga nima bo‘ldi? To‘rt: qaysi masalada fikrlar bo‘lingan? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Ehtiyoj bo‘lsa, tinglovni yana bir marta eslang.
scenes.say_uz: Savollarga javob bering. Qabul qachondan beri oshmoqda? Qachon keskin sakrash bo‘ldi? Raqamlarga nima bo‘ldi? Qaysi masalada fikrlar bo‘lingan?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: since twenty-fifteen. Two: during the pandemic. Three: the figures have levelled off. Four: opinions are divided on quality.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: 2015 yildan beri, “since” bilan present perfect ishlatilgan. Ikki: pandemiya vaqtida. Uch: raqamlar barqarorlashgan, “have levelled off”. To‘rt: sifat bo‘yicha. Mutaxassis “probably” so‘zi bilan ehtiyot bo‘ldi, bu keyingi mavzu: ishonch va shubhani bildirish. Amerika inglizchasida “levelled” o‘rniga “leveled” yoziladi, lekin ma’no bir xil.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: 2015 yildan beri. Ikki: pandemiya vaqtida. Uch: raqamlar barqarorlashgan. To‘rt: sifat bo‘yicha.

scenes.title: Ishonchni bildirish

examples.t: There is no doubt that technology has changed education.
examples.uz: Texnologiya ta’limni o‘zgartirgani shubhasiz.

examples.t: I am convinced that teachers will always be needed.
examples.uz: Ustozlar doim kerak bo‘lishiga ishonchim komil.

scenes.say: For strong certainty, use definitely, undoubtedly, there is no doubt that, it is clear that, or I am convinced that. Use them only when you have strong evidence. Strong certainty without proof sounds careless.
scenes.say_native: Kuchli ishonch uchun: definitely, undoubtedly, there is no doubt that, it is clear that, I am convinced that. Muhim: bunday iboralar faqat dalil kuchli bo‘lganda mos. Dalilsiz “100 percent sure” desangiz, fikr yengil eshitiladi. Shuning uchun keyingi ikki qadam ham kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli ishonch: definitely, undoubtedly, there is no doubt that, I am convinced that. Dalil kuchli bo‘lgandagina ishlating.

scenes.title: Ehtimollik darajalari
board: very likely: is bound to, is set to
likely: will probably, is likely to
unlikely: is unlikely to, is hardly likely to

examples.t: Schools are bound to use more AI tools.
examples.uz: Maktablar sun’iy intellekt vositalaridan ko‘proq foydalanishi aniq.

examples.t: Teachers may well become guides rather than lecturers.
examples.uz: Ustozlar ma’ruzachi emas, yo‘lboshchi bo‘lib qolishi mumkin.

scenes.say: Probability has levels. Very likely: is bound to. Likely: will probably, is likely to. Possible: may well, might, could. Unlikely: is unlikely to. Notice that may well is stronger than might.
scenes.say_native: Ehtimollik pog‘onalardan iborat. Juda ehtimol: is bound to, is set to. Ehtimol: will probably, is likely to. Mumkin: may well, might, could. Ehtimoldan yiroq: is unlikely to. “May well” “might” dan kuchliroq, ya’ni “ehtimoli yuqori”. Hozir bu so‘zlar sizga ikki xil kuch beradi: ishonchli bashorat va ehtiyotkor bashorat.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtimollik darajalari: is bound to juda ehtimol, will probably ehtimol, may well va might mumkin, is unlikely to ehtimoldan yiroq.

scenes.title: Shubha va ehtiyotkorlik
board: tend to, to some extent, in many cases
I am not entirely convinced that ...
It remains to be seen whether ...

examples.t: It remains to be seen whether AI will improve results.
examples.uz: Sun’iy intellekt natijalarni yaxshilaydimi-yo‘qmi, hali ko‘rinadi.

examples.t: Online lessons tend to work better with small groups.
examples.uz: Onlayn darslar odatda kichik guruhlarda yaxshiroq ishlaydi.

scenes.say: To show doubt or caution, use it seems that, it appears that, tend to, to some extent, I am not entirely convinced that, and it remains to be seen whether. This kind of language is called hedging.
scenes.say_native: Shubha yoki ehtiyotkorlikni ifodalash uchun: it seems that, it appears that, tend to, to some extent, in many cases, I am not entirely convinced that, it remains to be seen whether. Bunday til “hedging”, ya’ni ehtiyotkorlik deyiladi. U sizni ikkilanuvchi emas, balki dalilga ehtiyotkor yondashadigan odam qilib ko‘rsatadi. Akademik uslubda “always” va “never” o‘rniga “tend to” va “rarely” ko‘proq ishlatiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Shubha uchun: it seems that, tend to, to some extent, I am not entirely convinced, it remains to be seen. Bu ehtiyotkor til hedging deyiladi.

scenes.title: Taxmin: must, might, can’t
board: must have been / can’t have been (o‘tmish)

examples.t: He must be studying; his light is on.
examples.uz: U o‘qiyotgan bo‘lsa kerak, chiroqi yoniq.

examples.t: The test can’t have been that difficult.
examples.uz: Test u qadar qiyin bo‘lgan bo‘lishi mumkin emas.

scenes.say: For deduction about the present, use must for almost certain, might or could for possible, and cannot for impossible. For the past, use modal plus have plus past participle: must have been, can't have been.
scenes.say_native: Taxmin uchun modal fe’llar. Hozirgi zamon: must be, deyarli aniq; might, may, could be, mumkin; can’t be, mumkin emas. O‘tmish uchun: modal, have va uchinchi shakl: must have been, can’t have been. Diqqat: taxminda “must” majburiyatni emas, mantiqiy xulosani bildiradi.
scenes.say_uz: Hozirgi zamon taxmini: must be, might be, can’t be. O‘tmish uchun: must have been, can’t have been. Inkor uchun can’t ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Shubha va ehtimol: tipik xatolar
board: ✗ I am doubt.  ✓ I doubt it. / I am doubtful.
✗ It is maybe true.  ✓ Maybe it is true. / It may be true.
✗ I am 100% sure it will.  ✓ I am fairly sure it will.
scenes.say: Common mistakes. I doubt it, not I am doubt. Maybe goes at the start of the sentence, or use may be as two words after the subject. And I agree, not I am agree.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchi: “I am doubt” deyish. Ikkinchi: “maybe” va “may be”. “Maybe” bir so‘z, gap boshida: Maybe it is true. “May be” ikki so‘z, fe’l birikmasi: It may be true. Uchinchi: “I am agree”. O‘zbekchada “roziman” deymiz, shuning uchun “am” qo‘shiladi, lekin “agree” o‘zi fe’l: I agree.
scenes.say_uz: I doubt it, I am doubtful. Maybe gap boshida, may be ikki so‘z. I agree, I am agree emas.

scenes.title: Ishonch darajasini tartiblang
board: a) It might help some students.
b) It will definitely transform schools.
c) It is unlikely to replace teachers.
d) It is likely to change how we teach.
scenes.say: Put these four sentences in order from strongest certainty about change to weakest. A: it might help some students. B: it will definitely transform schools. C: it is unlikely to replace teachers. D: it is likely to change how we teach.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni o‘zgarishning ishonchlilik darajasi bo‘yicha kuchlidan zaifga tartiblang. A: it might help some students. B: it will definitely transform schools. C: it is unlikely to replace teachers. D: it is likely to change how we teach. Har bir gapdagi kalit so‘zga qarang va sababini aytib bering.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni ishonch darajasi bo‘yicha kuchlidan zaifga tartiblang. A: ba’zi o‘quvchilarga yordam berishi mumkin. B: maktablarni albatta o‘zgartiradi. C: ustozlarni almashtirishi ehtimoldan yiroq. D: o‘qitish usulini o‘zgartirishi ehtimol.

scenes.title: Javob
scenes.say: The order is: B, definitely. D, is likely. A, might. C, is unlikely to.
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: B, ya’ni definitely, eng kuchli. Keyin D, ya’ni is likely to. Keyin A, ya’ni might, ancha ehtiyotkor. Oxirida C, is unlikely to, bu o‘zgarish ehtimoldan yiroq, ya’ni inkorga yaqin. Eslatma: C gap inkor emas, lekin ehtimol pastligini bildiradi. Muhimi, fikrni ifodalashda o‘zingizga shu to‘rt pog‘onadan mos keladiganini tanlang.
scenes.say_uz: Tartib: B definitely, D is likely, A might, C is unlikely to.

scenes.title: Ehtiyotkor gapiring
scenes.say: Make each sentence more cautious. One: online exams are always fair. Two: robots will never teach. Three: everyone learns better online.
scenes.say_native: Uchta qat’iy gapni ehtiyotkorroq qilib qayta ayting. Birinchi: online exams are always fair. Ikkinchi: robots will never teach. Uchinchi: everyone learns better online. “Always”, “never” va “everyone” so‘zlarini yumshating, masalan “tend to”, “may”, “many” yordamida. Har birini baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni ehtiyotkorroq qiling. Onlayn imtihonlar doim adolatli. Robotlar hech qachon o‘qitmaydi. Hamma onlayn yaxshiroq o‘rganadi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: online exams tend to be fair. Two: robots are unlikely to replace teachers. Three: many students learn better online.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: Online exams tend to be fair. Ikki: Robots are unlikely to replace teachers. Uch: Many students seem to learn better online. Bu yerda mutlaq so‘zlar yumshoq iboralarga almashdi. Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lsa ham, “always”, “never” va “everyone” yo‘qolgan bo‘lsa, vazifa bajarilgan.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: onlayn imtihonlar odatda adolatli. Ikki: robotlar ustozlarni almashtirishi ehtimoldan yiroq. Uch: ko‘p o‘quvchilar onlayn yaxshiroq o‘rganadi.

scenes.title: Muvozanatli mulohaza tuzilmasi
scenes.say: A balanced argument has four parts. State the issue. Give advantages with a reason. Give disadvantages with a reason. Then finish with your own conclusion, which may favour one side but still acknowledges the other.
scenes.say_native: Muvozanatli mulohaza to‘rt qismdan iborat. Birinchi: mavzuni qo‘yish. Ikkinchi: afzalliklarni sabab bilan keltirish. Uchinchi: kamchiliklarni ham sabab bilan keltirish. To‘rtinchi: o‘z xulosangiz. Xulosa bir tomonga og‘ishi mumkin, lekin ikkinchi tomonni tan olishi kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Muvozanatli mulohaza: mavzu, sabab bilan afzalliklar, sabab bilan kamchiliklar va o‘z xulosangiz.

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshilik bog‘lovchilari
board: On the one hand ..., on the other hand ...

examples.t: While tablets are convenient, they can be distracting.
examples.uz: Planshetlar qulay bo‘lsa-da, chalg‘itishi mumkin.

examples.t: Despite the cost, many schools buy them.
examples.uz: Narxiga qaramay, ko‘p maktablar ularni sotib oladi.

scenes.say: For contrast, use on the one hand and on the other hand. Use while or whereas, and although, followed by a clause. Despite and in spite of are followed by a noun or an ing form. However and nevertheless start a new sentence.
scenes.say_native: Qarama-qarshilik uchun vositalar. On the one hand, on the other hand, ya’ni bir tomondan, ikkinchi tomondan. While va whereas, ya’ni “...bo‘lsa-da” va “...holbuki”, ortidan gap keladi. Although ham gap bilan. Despite va in spite of esa ot yoki -ing shakli bilan: despite the cost, despite being expensive.
scenes.say_uz: Qarama-qarshilik uchun: on the one hand, on the other hand, while, whereas, although, despite, however, nevertheless.

scenes.title: Tan olish va keltirish
board: There is some truth in this, but ...

examples.t: Admittedly, online lessons are flexible, but they lack personal contact.
examples.uz: To‘g‘ri, onlayn darslar moslashuvchan, lekin shaxsiy aloqa yetishmaydi.

examples.t: Critics claim that AI could reduce creativity.
examples.uz: Tanqidchilar sun’iy intellekt ijodkorlikni kamaytirishi mumkin deb da’vo qiladi.

scenes.say: To sound balanced, concede points. Admittedly, there is some truth in this. Report different views: proponents argue, critics claim, it can be argued that. Then give your view with however or nevertheless.
scenes.say_native: Muvozanatli ko‘rinish uchun qarshi tomonning haqligini tan oling: admittedly, there is some truth in this. Turli qarashlarni bayon qiling: proponents argue, ya’ni tarafdorlar fikricha; critics claim, tanqidchilar da’vo qiladi; it can be argued that, ... deb ham aytish mumkin. Keyin “however” yoki “nevertheless” bilan o‘z fikringizni qo‘shing.
scenes.say_uz: Qarshi tomonni tan oling: admittedly. Qarashlarni bayon qiling: proponents argue, critics claim. Keyin o‘z fikringizni however bilan qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy paragraf
scenes.say: Tablets in primary schools divide opinion. Proponents argue that they make lessons interactive and prepare children for a digital world. Admittedly, there is some truth in this. However, critics claim that excessive screen time harms concentration. On balance, tablets are useful when used in moderation.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy paragrafni tinglang. Mavzu: boshlang‘ich maktabda planshetlar. Avval tarafdorlar fikri, keyin tan olish, keyin tanqidchilar, oxirida muvozanatli xulosa. Bu tuzilma 25 soniyada eshitiladi, yozma ishda esa to‘rt gap bo‘ladi. Sinab ko‘ring: gaplarni sanang va “however” qayerda ekanini toping.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlang‘ich maktabda planshetlar haqida fikrlar bo‘lingan. Tarafdorlar ular darslarni interaktiv qilishini aytadi. To‘g‘ri, bu bir oz haqiqat. Biroq tanqidchilar ortiqcha ekran vaqti diqqatni susaytirishini da’vo qiladi. Umuman olganda, planshetlar me’yorida foydali.

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshilikdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Although it is expensive, but it is useful.
✓ Although it is expensive, it is useful.
✗ Despite of the cost  ✓ Despite the cost
✗ In spite the cost  ✓ In spite of the cost
scenes.say: Do not use although and but together. Although it is expensive, it is useful. Also, despite has no of, but in spite of has of. Despite the cost, in spite of the cost.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchi: “although” va “but” ni birga ishlatish. O‘zbekchada “garchi ... lekin” deyish mumkin, inglizchada esa faqat bittasi kerak: although it is expensive, it is useful. Ikkinchi: “despite of” deyish. To‘g‘risi: despite the cost. Uchinchi: “in spite the cost”. To‘g‘risi: in spite of the cost.
scenes.say_uz: Although va but birga kelmaydi. Despite of emas, despite. In spite the emas, in spite of.

scenes.title: Gaplarni bog‘lang
board: 1) Online classes are flexible. They are isolating. (while)
2) The laptops are expensive. Schools buy them. (despite)
3) Tests are stressful. They motivate students. (although)
scenes.say: Join the sentences. One: use while. Two: use despite, followed by a noun. Three: use although. Four: use nevertheless, and start a new sentence.
scenes.say_native: Ikki gapni berilgan so‘z bilan bog‘lang. Birinchi: while. Ikkinchi: despite, ortidan ot yoki -ing. Uchinchi: although. To‘rtinchi: nevertheless, ikkita alohida gap. Har bir gapni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting. Ichingizda xato yo‘qligini tekshiring: although bilan but yo‘q, despite bilan of yo‘q.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni bog‘lang. Onlayn darslar moslashuvchan. Ular yakkalab qo‘yadi. Noutbuklar qimmat. Maktablar ularni sotib oladi. Testlar stressli. Ular o‘quvchilarni rag‘batlantiradi. Ustozlar zarur. Texnologiya yordam beradi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) While online classes are flexible, they can be isolating.
2) Despite the cost, schools buy laptops.
3) Although tests are stressful, they motivate students.
4) Teachers are essential. Nevertheless, technology helps.
scenes.say: One: while online classes are flexible, they can be isolating. Two: despite the cost, schools buy laptops. Three: although tests are stressful, they motivate students. Four: teachers are essential. Nevertheless, technology helps.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: While online classes are flexible, they can be isolating. Ikki: Despite the cost, schools buy laptops, yoki despite laptops being expensive. Uch: Although tests are stressful, they motivate students. To‘rt: Teachers are essential. Nevertheless, technology helps. Agar sizniki biroz boshqacha bo‘lsa, muhimi bog‘lovchi to‘g‘ri tuzilma bilan kelgan bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: while bilan. Ikki: despite bilan. Uch: although bilan. To‘rt: nevertheless bilan yangi gap.

scenes.title: Tinglash: munozara
board: Mia: Phones should be banned in class.
Dev: Admittedly they distract, but they can help.
Mia: It seems to me the risks outweigh the benefits.
scenes.say: Mia: I think phones should be banned in class. Dev: Admittedly, they can be distracting. However, they also give students instant access to information. Mia: That is true to some extent, but it seems to me the risks outweigh the benefits. Dev: Perhaps a compromise would work. Phones could be allowed for research only.
scenes.say_native: Ikki talaba orasidagi munozarani tinglang. Mia telefonlarni darsda taqiqlashni xohlaydi. Dev esa tan olib, qarshi dalil keltiradi. Diqqat bilan eshiting: Dev nimani tan oladi, qanday foydani aytadi, Mia qaysi iboralar bilan qisman rozi bo‘ladi va Dev qanday kelishuv taklif qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Miya: Menimcha, telefonlar darsda taqiqlanishi kerak. Dev: To‘g‘ri, ular chalg‘itishi mumkin. Biroq ular o‘quvchilarga ma’lumotga tezkor kirish imkonini ham beradi. Miya: Bu ma’lum darajada to‘g‘ri, lekin menimcha, xavflar foydadan ustun. Dev: Balki murosa ishlar. Telefonlarga faqat izlanish uchun ruxsat berilishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Munozara bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3) Which phrase shows Mia partly agrees?
scenes.say: Answer. One: what does Dev admit? Two: what benefit does he mention? Three: which phrase shows Mia partly agrees? Four: what compromise does Dev suggest?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Bir: Dev nimani tan oladi? Ikki: u qanday foyda keltiradi? Uch: Miya qisman rozi ekanini qaysi ibora ko‘rsatadi? To‘rt: Dev qanday murosa taklif qiladi? Javoblaringizni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Dialogni yana eslang. Kimning gapi qaysi fikrga javob ekanini belgilang.
scenes.say_uz: Savollarga javob bering. Dev nimani tan oladi? U qanday foyda keltiradi? Miya qisman rozi ekanini qaysi ibora ko‘rsatadi? Dev qanday murosa taklif qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) That is true to some extent.
scenes.say: One: phones can be distracting. Two: instant access to information. Three: that is true to some extent. Four: allow phones for research only.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: telefonlar chalg‘itishi mumkinligini. Ikki: ma’lumotga tezkor kirish. Uch: “That is true to some extent”, ya’ni bu ma’lum darajada to‘g‘ri. Bu ibora mulohazangizni yumshatadi va hurmat bildiradi. To‘rt: faqat izlanish uchun ruxsat berish. Ko‘ryapsizmi, murosa ham muvozanatli mulohazaning tabiiy yakuni bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: telefonlar chalg‘itishi mumkin. Ikki: ma’lumotga tezkor kirish. Uch: bu ma’lum darajada to‘g‘ri. To‘rt: telefonlar faqat izlanish uchun.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: so‘z urg‘usi
scenes.say: Word stress matters in this topic. Education, technology, artificial, curriculum. Algorithm has stress on the first syllable. Plagiarism has stress on the first syllable too. Privacy in British English is PRIvacy, in American English it is often PRYvacy.
scenes.say_native: Mavzuga oid so‘zlarda urg‘uni to‘g‘ri qo‘ying. Education: ed-u-CA-tion, ikkinchi yarmidagi “ca” da. Technology: tech-NO-lo-gy, “no” da. Artificial: ar-ti-FI-cial. Curriculum: cur-RI-cu-lum. Algorithm va plagiarism: birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Privacy britaniya inglizchasida “PRIvasi”, amerika inglizchasida ko‘pincha “PRAYvasi”.
scenes.say_uz: So‘z urg‘usi muhim: educaTION, techNOlogy, artiFIcial, curRIculum. Algorithm va plagiarism birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Privacy britaniya va amerika talaffuzida farq qiladi.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say: Repeat. Education. Technology. Artificial. Curriculum. Algorithm. Plagiarism. Privacy.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Har bir so‘zni ikki marta ayting, urg‘uli bo‘g‘inni biroz uzunroq va balandroq. Masalan, “techNOlogy”, “no” da kuchli, qolgan bo‘g‘inlar qisqa va yengil. O‘zbekcha ritmda hamma bo‘g‘in teng aytiladi, inglizchada esa urg‘usiz bo‘g‘inlar qisqaradi.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang. Ta’lim. Texnologiya. Sun’iy. O‘quv dasturi. Algoritm. Plagiat. Maxfiylik.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: 40 soniya gapiring
scenes.say: Final task. Speak for forty seconds: does technology improve education? Use a trend phrase, a certainty or doubt phrase, and a contrast linker.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. Qirq soniya gapiring: texnologiya ta’limni yaxshilaydimi? Quyidagilarni ishlating: bitta tendensiya iborasi, masalan “has risen steadily”, bitta ishonch yoki shubha iborasi, masalan “it seems that”, va bitta qarama-qarshilik bog‘lovchisi, masalan “while”. Oxirida muvozanatli xulosa qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa. Qirq soniya gapiring: texnologiya ta’limni yaxshilaydimi? Tendensiya iborasi, ishonch yoki shubha iborasi va qarama-qarshilik bog‘lovchisidan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Online courses have grown steadily; it seems that results vary; while flexible, they lack contact; on balance ...
scenes.say: Online courses have grown steadily in recent years. It seems that results vary. While they are flexible and affordable, they can be isolating. On balance, technology is likely to improve education, provided teachers remain at the centre.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. “Online courses have grown steadily in recent years. It seems that results vary. While they are flexible and affordable, they can be isolating. On balance, technology is likely to improve education, provided teachers remain at the centre.” Ko‘rdingizmi: tendensiya, ehtiyotkor til, qarama-qarshilik va xulosa. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha, lekin shu to‘rt qism bo‘lsa, siz vazifani bajardingiz.
scenes.say_uz: Onlayn kurslar so‘nggi yillarda muttasil o‘sdi. Natijalar turlicha ko‘rinadi. Ular moslashuvchan va arzon bo‘lsa-da, yakkalab qo‘yishi mumkin. Umuman, texnologiya ta’limni yaxshilashi ehtimol, bunda ustozlar markazda qolsa.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Certainty and doubt: bound to, may well, tend to
scenes.say: Let's review. We learned topic vocabulary and collocations, how to describe trends and their causes, how to show certainty and doubt, and how to build a balanced argument with contrast linkers.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: ta’lim va texnologiya lug‘ati hamda birikmalar. Ikkinchi: tendensiya fe’llari, ravishlari, zamonlari va sabab-oqibat iboralari. Uchinchi: ishonch va shubha, ya’ni bound to, may well, tend to. To‘rtinchi: muvozanatli mulohaza: while, despite, admittedly, however. Bu vositalar IELTS speaking va writing’da fikringizni boy va ishonchli ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say_uz: Biz mavzu lug‘atini, tendensiyalarni va ularning sabablarini tasvirlashni, ishonch va shubhani bildirishni hamda muvozanatli mulohaza tuzishni o‘rgandik.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Use 3 phrases for certainty or doubt, 2 contrast linkers, 1 trend phrase
scenes.say: Your homework is to speak for two minutes on this question: will AI replace teachers? Record yourself and check that you used certainty and doubt phrases, contrast linkers, and a balanced conclusion. Next time we will practise listening for the main idea and detail.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: “Will AI replace teachers?” savoliga ikki daqiqa gapiring va ovozingizni yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida uchta ishonch yoki shubha iborasi, ikkita qarama-qarshilik bog‘lovchisi, bitta tendensiya iborasi va muvozanatli xulosa. Keyingi darsda tinglab tushunish: asosiy g‘oya va tafsilotlarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: sun’iy intellekt ustozlarni almashtiradimi, degan savolga ikki daqiqa gapiring. Keyingi darsda tinglab tushunishda asosiy g‘oya va tafsilotni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: “Will AI replace teachers?” savoliga ikki daqiqa gapiring va ovozingizni yozing: kamida uchta ishonch yoki shubha iborasi, ikkita qarama-qarshilik bog‘lovchisi, bitta tendensiya iborasi va muvozanatli xulosa bo‘lsin.

quiz.q: Choose the correct collocation: "She wants to ___ a degree in law."

options: I passed exam yesterday without result.
quiz.why_uz: Take/sit an exam. "Make an exam" xato.
Increased by 10% — o‘zgarish miqdori by bilan beriladi.

options: The number of students are growing.
The number of students is growing.
A number of students is growing.
quiz.why_uz: The number of ... birlikda: is growing.

quiz.q: Which phrase expresses the strongest certainty?

quiz.why_uz: "I doubt it" to‘g‘ri. "I am doubt" xato.

options: Although it is costly, but it is useful.
Although it is costly, it is useful.
Despite of the cost, it is useful.
In spite the cost, it is useful.

quiz.q: "He ___ be at work; his car is outside and the light is on."
Which linker is followed by a noun?

options: While technology can improve access, it may reduce personal contact.
quiz.why_uz: Muvozanatli gap ikki tomonni ham ko‘rsatadi.
